svg.title: MAP3 — exact added collision footprints
svg.desc: Two stages at the same 4 pixels per world unit. Light outlines show original decks and ramps; colors show all added collider projections, including overhead members. Rotated portal boxes use their actual oriented footprint.
svg.text: Same scale: 4 px / WU. Both panels use X −48…48, Z −76…76. +Z points down.
Colored footprints include overhead structures; overlap in this plan does not mean a blocked route at deck height.
212 added parts · all nonpaintable · exact definitions in JSON
93 added parts · all nonpaintable · exact definitions in JSON
Exterior quays and mounted face details have no additional collision and are intentionally omitted from this collision plan.
